sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can multiply fractions and mixed numbers by multiplying numerators and denominators.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Multiplying fractions -- To multiply fractions, multiply the numerators together and multiply the denominators together. Simplify if possible.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Multiply the numerators together and the denominators together. Simplify the result.
&frac{a}{b} × &frac{c}{d} = &frac{a × c}{b × d}
Top times top, bottom times bottom

Key examples:
  ✓ &frac{2}{3} × &frac{4}{5} = &frac{8}{15}  (multiply tops, multiply bottoms)
  ✓ &frac{3}{4} × &frac{2}{9} = &frac{1}{6}  (cross-cancel 3 and 9)
  ✓ &frac{1}{2} × &frac{1}{3} = &frac{1}{6}  (unit fractions)
  ✗ &frac{2}{3} × &frac{4}{5} = &frac{6}{8}  (added instead of multiplied)
  ✗ &frac{3}{4} × &frac{2}{9} = &frac{6}{36}  (correct but not simplified)
